octop-execution.title: Octop Harness / ACP
octop-execution.configuration_only: The model identity is a configuration acknowledgment only; it does not verify the actual provider or model used.
octop-execution.observe_only: The budget is observe-only. Fixed step and output settings do not establish a hard spending limit or complete billing evidence.
octop-execution.workspace_boundary: Execution uses Suma’s administrator-fixed runtime and native workspace tools. An ACP cwd alone does not prove worktree isolation, and this does not attest the entire Python environment or a signed runtime.
octop-execution.stop_boundary: A protocol stop reason and a cancellation request do not confirm that a process stopped. Reconcile the original operation when the process or its effects are uncertain. Independent tests and human acceptance remain separate.
octop-execution.setup_intro: Configure the dedicated Octop Harness / ACP coding runtime on an execution node. This local template does not install software, connect to Octop or dispatch a task.
octop-execution.setup_runtime_help: Use the actual absolute Python executable, locally packaged .pyz bundle and its manifest in the same directory. Go validates their contents during the probe; this form cannot verify files on another machine.
octop-execution.setup_checks: Fixed check identifiers, separated by commas
octop-execution.setup_checks_help: Choose 1–16 distinct administrator-registered checks. Keep the runtime manifest beside the .pyz bundle; task text cannot choose commands or runtime files.
octop-execution.setup_key_help: Enter a variable name such as OCTOP_MODEL_API_KEY, not the key value. Go reads the named credential separately; no env_from list or Suma platform credential is copied into this template.
octop-execution.setup_incomplete: Complete the fixed model, absolute runtime paths and checks before copying. Invalid URLs, out-of-range parameters or missing inputs keep the configuration unavailable.
octop-execution.setup_probe: Save the local command configuration and run the existing Runner describe-tools probe with the explicit repository and full base commit. Inspect actual runtime, SDK and protocol observations.
octop-execution.setup_import: Import the actual inventory into the project, review and enable the fixed profile. A successful probe does not prove model authorization, development success or provider identity.
octop-execution.setup_dispatch: Preview a task using the fixed tool and workflow. Execute in an isolated attempt, test the exact candidate independently and complete the existing human acceptance gate.
octop-execution.setup_product_boundary: This entry integrates the Octop Harness coding runtime through ACP. The full Octop console, user agent teams, channels and MCP connector management are separate capabilities.
